zh: 热大爆炸
en: Hot big bang

zh: 从奇点算起 §0§。今天的背景温度 §1§ K，往回追溯足够热，有核合成和 CMB。
en: §0§ since the singularity. Background temperature today §1§ K; traced back it is hot enough for nucleosynthesis and a CMB.

zh: 大爆炸，但是冷的
en: A big bang, but a cold one

zh: 从奇点算起 §0§；没有辐射，温度始终为零：没有核合成，也没有 CMB。
en: §0§ since the singularity; no radiation, the temperature is always zero: no nucleosynthesis and no CMB.

zh: 大爆炸，但空无一物
en: A big bang, but an empty one

zh: 从奇点算起 §0§；没有物质也没有辐射，所谓"大爆炸"只是坐标的起点（米尔恩宇宙其实就是闵可夫斯基时空的一块）。
en: §0§ since the singularity; no matter and no radiation, so the "big bang" is only the origin of the coordinates (the Milne universe is really a patch of Minkowski spacetime).

zh: 量子反弹代替奇点
en: A quantum bounce instead of a singularity

zh: 圈量子宇宙学的有效方程在密度到 ρ_c 时把收缩翻成膨胀：反弹在 §0§前，最小 a = §1§，那时温度 §2§ K。
en: The effective equations of loop quantum cosmology turn contraction into expansion when the density reaches ρ_c: the bounce was §0§ ago, at minimum a = §1§, when the temperature was §2§ K.

zh: 足够热，核合成和 CMB 照常。
en: Hot enough: nucleosynthesis and the CMB happen as usual.

zh: 不够热：核合成没有发生过。
en: Not hot enough: nucleosynthesis never happened.

zh: 没有大爆炸（反弹）
en: No big bang (a bounce)

zh: 过去收缩到最小 a = §0§ 后反弹。从没热过：没有氦、没有 CMB——真实宇宙的观测排除了它。
en: In the past it contracted to a minimum a = §0§ and bounced. It was never hot: no helium, no CMB — observations of the real universe rule it out.

zh: 没有奇点，无限的过去
en: No singularity, an infinite past

zh: 密度不发散，膨胀只是指数地从极小开始（de Sitter 式）。也没有热的开端。
en: The density never diverges; the expansion simply starts exponentially from something tiny (de Sitter-like). No hot beginning either.

zh: 结构形成：不适用
en: Structure formation: not applicable

zh: 没有热大爆炸就没有原初扰动的常规剧本，这里不做判断。
en: Without a hot big bang there is no standard script for primordial perturbations; no verdict here.

zh: 10⁸ M☉ 的 3σ 高峰在 a = §0§（背景温度 §1§ K）越过坍缩阈值 δ = 1.686。
en: 3σ peaks of 10⁸ M☉ cross the collapse threshold δ = 1.686 at a = §0§ (background temperature §1§ K).

zh: 像银河系那样的典型星系（10¹² M☉ 的 1σ 涨落）在 §0§坍缩；
en: A typical galaxy like the Milky Way (a 1σ fluctuation of 10¹² M☉) collapses §0§;

zh: 大爆炸后 §0§
en: §0§ after the big bang

zh: 今天之后 §0§
en: §0§ after today

zh: 典型星系尺度（10¹² M☉ 的 1σ）永远到不了阈值；
en: the typical galaxy scale (1σ at 10¹² M☉) never reaches the threshold;

zh: 星系团尺度（8 h⁻¹Mpc 的 1σ）在 §0§坍缩。
en: the cluster scale (1σ at 8 h⁻¹Mpc) collapses §0§.

zh: 星系团尺度（8 h⁻¹Mpc 的 1σ）永远到不了阈值——真实的星系团是 2–3σ 的稀有高峰。
en: the cluster scale (1σ at 8 h⁻¹Mpc) never reaches the threshold — real clusters are rare 2–3σ peaks.

zh: 第一批星系在§0§后 §1§ 形成
en: The first galaxies form §1§ after the §0§

zh: 反弹
en: bounce

zh: 大爆炸
en: big bang

zh: 宇宙里没有物质：没有东西可以在引力下聚集。
en: There is no matter in this universe: nothing can gather under gravity.

zh: 原初扰动太弱：幅度只有我们宇宙的 §0§ 倍（A_s 是 §1§ 倍），同样的增长下最高的密度峰只到 δ = §2§；按我们宇宙的幅度本来可以长到 §3§。
en: The primordial perturbations are too weak: their amplitude is only §0§ times ours (A_s is §1§ times), so with the same growth the highest density peak only reaches δ = §2§; with our amplitude it could have grown to §3§.

zh: 宇宙在大爆炸后 §0§ 就大坍缩了，到那时最高的密度峰也只长到 δ = §1§，没来得及坍缩成星系就被压碎了。
en: The universe reaches its Big Crunch only §0§ after the big bang; by then the highest density peak has grown only to δ = §1§, and it is crushed before it can collapse into a galaxy.

zh: 辐射主导得太久（物质-辐射相等§0§），辐射压让物质扰动几乎不长（Mészáros 效应），最高的密度峰也只到 δ ≈ §1§。
en: Radiation dominates for too long (matter–radiation equality §0§); radiation pressure keeps matter perturbations from growing (the Mészáros effect), and the highest density peak only reaches δ ≈ §1§.

zh: 要到 a = §0§
en: only at a = §0§

zh: 到今天还没发生
en: has not happened yet today

zh: 之后暗能量又在 a = §0§ 接管，把增长彻底冻住。
en: Then dark energy takes over at a = §0§ and freezes the growth completely.

zh: 暗能量过早接管（物质-暗能量相等在 a = §0§），增长被冻结：最高的密度峰也只长到 δ = §1§ < 1.686，永远形不成星系。这正是温伯格 1987 年用来"预言"宇宙学常数不能比我们的大太多的论证。
en: Dark energy takes over too early (matter–dark-energy equality at a = §0§) and the growth freezes: the highest density peak only reaches δ = §1§ < 1.686, so galaxies never form. This is exactly the argument Weinberg used in 1987 to "predict" that the cosmological constant cannot be much larger than ours.

zh: 密度峰最多长到 δ = §0§，不够坍缩（开放宇宙的曲率让膨胀太快，增长在 a ≈ Ω_m/|Ω_k| 后冻结）。
en: Density peaks grow at most to δ = §0§, not enough to collapse (the curvature of an open universe makes the expansion too fast; growth freezes after a ≈ Ω_m/|Ω_k|).

zh: 没有星系
en: No galaxies

zh: 恒星可以燃烧到自然终老
en: Stars can burn out naturally

zh: 永远膨胀并加速：其他星系最终退出视界，每个星系群成为孤岛，但本地的恒星不受影响。
en: Expands forever and accelerates: other galaxies eventually leave the horizon and every galaxy group becomes an island, but local stars are unaffected.

zh: 永远膨胀、不加速：没有事件视界，整个宇宙保持因果联系。
en: Expands forever without accelerating: no event horizon, the whole universe stays in causal contact.

zh: 星系形成后还有 §0§
en: §0§ left after galaxies form

zh: 够类太阳恒星走完一生，然后一切被大坍缩压回奇点。
en: Enough for Sun-like stars to live out their lives; then the Big Crunch presses everything back into a singularity.

zh: 够类太阳恒星走完一生，然后大撕裂把星系、恒星、原子逐级撕开。
en: Enough for Sun-like stars to live out their lives; then the Big Rip tears apart galaxies, stars and atoms, one scale after another.

zh: 星系形成后只剩 §0§
en: Only §0§ left after galaxies form

zh: 大质量恒星来得及，类太阳恒星和行星上的演化大概来不及。
en: Enough for massive stars; probably not enough for Sun-like stars and for evolution on planets.

zh: 星系刚形成 §0§ 就结束了
en: It all ends §0§ after galaxies form

zh: 没有恒星来得及走完一生。
en: No star gets to live out its life.
